procedures.intro: Send the software licence renewal for {n} seats. We use {name} - renewals go to {value}.

Software renewal time - {n} seats please.

procedures.intro: Order {n} boxes of envelopes, please. Stationery comes from {name} ({value}).

Brindle & Moss bank rec on {date} - put it in the calendar.

procedures.title: the Copper Kettle till float request

procedures.intro: Send this quarter's VAT summary to Brindle & Moss's books contact: GBP {n} due. That's {name} ({value}).

VAT summary to the Brindle & Moss books contact please - GBP {n}.

procedures.title: the Copper Kettle wage summary

short: Send the Copper Kettle's manager the weekly wage summary: GBP {n}.

procedures.title: the payment-terms reminder
procedures.intro: Email my clients ({to}) the monthly reminder of my payment terms: invoices are due within {value}.
short: Email my clients the monthly reminder of my payment terms.
Send the clients the payment-terms reminder for this month.

procedures.title: the late-fee reminder
procedures.intro: Send my clients ({to}) the reminder about the late-payment fee: {value} a month on overdue invoices.
short: Send my clients the reminder about the late-payment fee.
Late-fee reminder to the clients please.

procedures.title: the records-keeping reminder
procedures.fact: how long clients must keep their records
procedures.intro: Email my clients ({to}) the yearly reminder: keep receipts and bank records for {value}.
short: Email my clients the reminder about how long to keep their records.
Send the clients the records-keeping reminder.
procedures.doc_rule: Keep receipts and bank records for {n} years
